pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [1439, 787, 1483, 904] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.
